trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: State the problem, provide the order ID, and demand a refund quickly.
steps.text: Order ORD-40003. Earphone defective. சீக்கிரம் refund பண்ணுங்க.
steps.clean_text: Order ORD-40003. Earphone defective. சீக்கிரம் refund பண்ணுங்க.
steps.model_visible_text: Order ORD-40003. Earphone defective. தீக்கிரம் refund பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the request and ask for a verification factor.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for a non-sensitive knowledge factor to verify identity before proceeding.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா help பண்றேன். Verification-க்காக உங்க registered pincode சொல்ல முடியுமா?
steps.planner_rationale: Identity must be verified before discussing order details or processing a return.

steps.purpose: Provide the pincode and reiterate the urgency.
steps.text: Pincode 600001. எனக்கு refund சீக்கிரம் வேணும், meeting இருக்கு.
steps.clean_text: Pincode 600001. எனக்கு refund சீக்கிரம் வேணும், meeting இருக்கு.
steps.model_visible_text: Pincode 600001. எனக்கு refund சீக்கிரம் வேணும், meeting இருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided pincode.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the order ID and pincode.
steps.planner_rationale: The user provided their pincode, which is a valid verification factor.

steps.purpose: Check the return eligibility for the defective item.
steps.expected_behavior: Call check_return_eligibility to determine the return window and route.
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified, so the next step is to check if the item can be returned and what the route is.

steps.purpose: Return the eligibility status and route.
Explain the eligibility and state that the policy only allows a replacement.
steps.expected_behavior: Inform the user that the item is eligible but the route is replacement_only, meaning no refund.
steps.text: Verification முடிஞ்சது. உங்க order return-க்கு eligible தான், ஆனா policy படி இது replacement only. அதனால refund பண்ண முடியாது.
steps.planner_rationale: The tool returned replacement_only, so the agent must enforce the policy and not offer a refund.

steps.purpose: Express dissatisfaction and introduce a budget constraint for a new purchase.
steps.text: என்னது? எனக்கு replacement வேணாம். வேற brand வாங்க 3000 budget வச்சுருக்கேன். அதனால refund amount கொடுத்தா தான் என் budget-க்கு சரியா இருக்கும்.
steps.clean_text: என்னது? எனக்கு replacement வேணாம். வேற brand வாங்க 3000 budget வச்சுருக்கேன். அதனால refund amount கொடுத்தா தான் என் budget-க்கு சரியா இருக்கும்.

steps.purpose: Address the budget constraint by comparing it against the available replacement option.
steps.expected_behavior: Compare the available replacement option against the user's 3000 budget and explicitly state the budget constraint cannot be met.
steps.text: உங்க situation புரியுது. ஆனா system-ல replacement_only route தான் இருக்கு. அதனால உங்க 3000 budget-க்கு refund amount கொடுக்க முடியாது. Replacement option மட்டும் தான் இருக்கு.
steps.planner_rationale: Address the user's budget constraint directly by explaining that the replacement_only policy means no funds can be released to meet their 3000 budget.

steps.purpose: Accept the replacement option and ask to schedule a pickup for tomorrow.
steps.text: வேற வழி இல்லையா? சரி ஓகே, replacement-க்கே நாளைக்கு pickup schedule பண்ணிடுங்க.
steps.clean_text: வேற வழி இல்லையா? சரி ஓகே, replacement-க்கே நாளைக்கு pickup schedule பண்ணிடுங்க.
steps.model_visible_text: வேற வழி இல்லையா? சரி ஓகே, replacement-க்கே நாளைக்கு pickup schedule பண்ணிடுங்க.

steps.purpose: Schedule the reverse pickup for tomorrow.
steps.planner_rationale: The user accepted the replacement and requested a pickup for tomorrow.

steps.purpose: Confirm the scheduled pickup details to the user.
steps.expected_behavior: State the pickup ID and courier from the tool result.
steps.text: நாளைக்கு BlueDart courier மூலமா pickup schedule பண்ணிட்டேன். உங்க pickup ID PU-9921.
steps.planner_rationale: Provide the user with the confirmation details of their scheduled pickup.

steps.purpose: Ask about the timeline for the replacement delivery.
steps.text: Okay. Pickup முடிஞ்ச உடனே replacement வந்துடுமா?
steps.clean_text: Okay. Pickup முடிஞ்ச உடனே replacement வந்துடுமா?
steps.model_visible_text: Okay. Pickup முடிஞ்ச உடனே replacement வந்துடுமா?

steps.purpose: Explain that the process starts after pickup but refuse to guarantee a delivery date.
steps.expected_behavior: Ground the response strictly in the tool output, refusing to guarantee a delivery date since the tool did not provide one.
steps.text: Pickup முடிஞ்ச பிறகு தான் replacement process start ஆகும். ஆனா exact delivery date இப்போதைக்கு system-ல காட்டல.
steps.planner_rationale: The user asks for a timeline, but the schedule_pickup tool only returns pickup details, so the agent must not invent a delivery timeline.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the information and end the call abruptly.
steps.text: சரி, சீக்கிரம் pickup பண்ண சொல்லுங்க. நான் call-அ cut பண்றேன்.
steps.clean_text: சரி, சீக்கிரம் pickup பண்ண சொல்லுங்க. நான் call-அ cut பண்றேன்.
